PD-L1 tumor

Discussion and conclusion

segments.exact_quote: Pulmonary enteric adenocarcinoma (PEAC), also known as the
intestinal variant of lung adenocarcinoma, is a very rare subtype of

source_units.text:
Pulmonary enteric adenocarcinoma (PEAC), also known as the
intestinal variant of lung adenocarcinoma, is a very rare subtype of
NSCLC.

segments.exact_quote: It was first described by Tsao and Fraser in 1991 (5) and was
officially classified as a histological type of lung adenocarcinoma in the
2015 World Health Organization histological classification of lung

source_units.text:
It was first described by Tsao and Fraser in 1991 (5) and was
officially classified as a histological type of lung adenocarcinoma in the
2015 World Health Organization histological classification of lung
tumors.

According to the WHO criteria (1), the diagnosis of PEAC
requires: 1.Primary pulmonary origin; 2.

≥50% tumor composition
showing intestinal-type differentiation; 3.Morphological overlap with
colorectal adenocarcinoma.
